newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila firms assign oil stake to Texaco unit.
newsitem.headline: Manila firms assign oil stake to Texaco unit.

text.p: Five Manila companies said on Wednesday they were assigning their stakes in an oil exploration project in Thailand to Texaco Exploration (Thailand) Ltd, a unit of U.S.-based Texaco Inc.
Basic Petroleum & Minerals Inc said in a statement it is selling its 12.3460 percent stake in Thailand's Block 12/32 oil exploration project for $740,760.
Palawan Oil & Gas Exploration Inc and First Abacus Financial Holdings Corp said in a joint statement they are assigning each of their 5.0 percent stakes in the project to Texaco for $300,000 each.
APC Group Inc and Sinophil Corp said in a joint statement that they were selling 50 percent of their interests in the same concession to Texaco Exploration.
In return, they will not have to share the cost of a well the consortium is planning to drill on the site unless it exceeds $7.2 million, APC and Sinophil said.
APC will retain a 2.5 percent stake and Sinophil 1.0 percent.
